HediffDef.label: arcane attunement
HediffDef.description: This person has awakened to the arcane. Their attributes and skill tree shape their power.

HediffDef.label: conjured
HediffDef.description: A creature called into being by magic. It will dissipate when the spell ends.

HediffDef.label: risen
HediffDef.description: Dragged back from death by necromancy. Feels no pain, needs nothing, and will collapse when the binding ends.

HediffDef.label: dominated
HediffDef.description: This mind is bound to another's will.

HediffDef.label: polymorphed
HediffDef.description: Temporarily transformed into a harmless creature.

HediffDef.label: arcane burning
HediffDef.description: Clinging arcane flames sear the flesh.

HediffDef.label: chilled
HediffDef.description: Biting cold slows every movement.

HediffDef.label: frozen
HediffDef.description: Encased in ice. Barely able to move, and the ice makes the flesh beneath brittle.

HediffDef.label: shocked
HediffDef.description: Muscles spasm with lingering current.

HediffDef.label: arcane venom
HediffDef.description: A magical toxin eats away at the body.

HediffDef.label: black plague
HediffDef.description: A necromantic plague. Victims who die from it burst and spread the sickness to those nearby.

HediffDef.label: hemorrhage hex
HediffDef.description: A blood curse keeps wounds from closing.

HediffDef.label: enfeebled
HediffDef.description: Strength drains from the limbs and focus from the eyes.

HediffDef.label: doomed
HediffDef.description: A hex that makes the victim suffer more from every wound. Severity deepens the curse.

HediffDef.label: sundered
HediffDef.description: Armor and hide are torn by magic. Stacks.

HediffDef.label: time-slowed
HediffDef.description: Caught in a slowed pocket of time.

HediffDef.label: silenced
HediffDef.description: Unable to weave spells.

HediffDef.label: judged
HediffDef.description: Marked for judgment. Holy light and allied weapons find this target more easily.

HediffDef.label: entangled
HediffDef.description: Bound by roots and vines.

HediffDef.label: blinded
HediffDef.description: Searing light or shadow blots out the eyes.

HediffDef.label: withering curse
HediffDef.description: The victim's healing fails and their flesh ages.

HediffDef.label: pied
HediffDef.description: Hit square in the face with a conjured custard pie. Humiliating, and hard to see through.

HediffDef.label: concussed
HediffDef.description: Ears ringing, vision swimming.

HediffDef.label: voidtouched
HediffDef.description: Reality frays around the victim. Void damage is amplified and armor fails.

HediffDef.label: hastened
HediffDef.description: Time flows faster around this person.

HediffDef.label: empowered
HediffDef.description: Brimming with arcane energy. Stacks.

HediffDef.label: stoneskin
HediffDef.description: Skin hardened to living stone.

HediffDef.label: blessed
HediffDef.description: Divine favor wards body and mind.

HediffDef.label: regenerating
HediffDef.description: Wounds knit closed before your eyes.

HediffDef.label: valor
HediffDef.description: Stirred by a war song: braver, stronger, steadier.

HediffDef.label: arcane focus
HediffDef.description: Mind sharpened to a razor's edge.

HediffDef.label: fire ward
HediffDef.description: Immune to flame and wrapped in heat.

HediffDef.label: ursine form
HediffDef.description: Shaped into the might of a great bear: thick hide, crushing blows.

HediffDef.label: lupine form
HediffDef.description: Shaped into a swift, savage wolf.

HediffDef.label: thrumbo avatar
HediffDef.description: The primal shape of the thrumbo: near-invulnerable, unstoppable.

HediffDef.label: shrouded
HediffDef.description: Wrapped in shadow, unseen by enemies.

HediffDef.label: blood frenzy
HediffDef.description: Driven by the taste of blood.

HediffDef.label: divine shield
HediffDef.description: Untouchable for a few precious moments.

HediffDef.label: lichform
HediffDef.description: A body half-dead, all power. No pain, no hunger, terrible magic.

HediffDef.label: avatar of light
HediffDef.description: A blazing vessel of the divine.

HediffDef.label: stormborn
HediffDef.description: Riding the lightning.

HediffDef.label: mana surge
HediffDef.description: Mana pours in faster than it can be spent.

HediffDef.label: rune-charged
HediffDef.description: Weapons and reflexes hum with runic power.

HediffDef.label: barkskin
HediffDef.description: Skin hardened into living bark.

HediffDef.label: rallied
HediffDef.description: Spirits lifted by a rousing song.

HediffDef.label: lucky
HediffDef.description: Fortune smiles. For now.

HediffDef.label: ironhide
HediffDef.description: Runes of warding etched into the skin.

HediffDef.label: phoenix wings
HediffDef.description: Wings of living flame lift and shield the caster.

HediffDef.label: timelocked
HediffDef.description: Frozen outside the flow of time. Cannot be harmed, cannot act.

HediffDef.label: phase-shifted
HediffDef.description: Partly slipped out of reality; attacks pass through.

HediffDef.label: sanctified
HediffDef.description: Holy ground strengthens the faithful.

HediffDef.label: chronal shield
HediffDef.description: Incoming harm is slowed to a crawl.

HediffDef.label: shadowstep
HediffDef.description: Moving between shadows.
